subject: James return concern; reviews and chain status reconciled
body:
For Ziggy: Grok returned the one James gun-removal request. It keeps the broad character/scene, but the belt repeats, trousers at the patch are smeared and metal remnants remain; I visually checked the full image and close-up. This is needs fixes / blocking draft, not an accepted master. The exact source is preserved. Nine provider files are on D: and independent hash/pixel checks are underway. No further generation or duplicate request started.

The latest full review21 intake is complete:199 canonical rows,36 favorites preserved; Site’s E3 review refresh passed7suites. BOSS-008 crocodile is now recorded as first-choice golden visible identity/proportions reference. Claude is carrying James’s brother relationship into writer continuity with other backstory marked proposed.

Chain status is an execution gap, not another approval request: Neck24 was approved but never launched; the separate50smoking-prop request was sent/acknowledged but remains unfulfilled. The50receivedv003mouth studies are a different collection. Coordinate with CFA NOVA; do not duplicate provider jobs.
